description: Defines a ReadableProduct class representing a product entity with descriptions, pricing, images, manufacturer, and attributes, extending ProductEntity and implementing Serializable.

classes.name: ReadableProduct
classes.description: A data transfer object encapsulating product details such as description, pricing, images, manufacturer, and attributes.

methods.name: getFinalPrice
methods.description: Returns the final price of the product.

methods.name: setFinalPrice
methods.description: Sets the final price of the product.

methods.name: getOriginalPrice
methods.description: Returns the original price of the product.

methods.name: setOriginalPrice
methods.description: Sets the original price of the product.

methods.name: isDiscounted
methods.description: Checks if the product is discounted.

methods.name: setDiscounted
methods.description: Sets whether the product is discounted.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Returns the list of product images.

methods.name: setImages
methods.description: Sets the list of product images.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns the main image of the product.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns the list of product attributes.
